name: itecs-halopsa
description: ITECS HaloPSA tools for technician operations and billing evidence.

interface.longDescription: Provides 32 typed HaloPSA tools for lookups plus approval-gated ticket actions, Start Work, email, notes, time entries, ticket/project create and update, and contract create and update. Every write previews the exact payload, commits once after the connector-required confirmation, and requires independent readback. Per-technician 1Password setup supports macOS and Windows. Deletion and raw passthrough are excluded.
defaultPrompt: List HaloPSA purchase orders that need CFO review.
Look up a HaloPSA client, invoice, contract, PO, ticket, or project.
Add an approved client-visible note to an exact HaloPSA ticket.
Create a HaloPSA ticket from my details and ask only for required information that is missing.
Move an exact HaloPSA ticket to an approved status after revalidation.
Add a private note or time entry to an exact HaloPSA ticket.
Run the exact available Start Work action for a HaloPSA ticket.
Send an approved ticket email through a configured HaloPSA action outcome.
Create or update a HaloPSA project or client contract from a conversational request.
